## Problem 1: Plane wave in a lossless medium

A uniform plane wave travels in a lossless dielectric with relative permittivity 4.

### (a) Phase velocity [60 pts] [handwritten]
Find the phase velocity of the wave in the dielectric.

> grading_prompt: Required elements: (1) the formula for phase velocity; (2) the value 1.5e8 m/s.

### (b) Wavelength [40 pts] [handwritten:human]

> grader_note: The wavelength is half the free-space wavelength.
